description: Represents a single task in a Gantt chart.

members.name: ActualCost
members.description: Actual monetary cost incurred so far.

members.name: Assignees
members.description: People assigned to this task.

members.name: Attachments
members.description: Files attached to this task.

members.name: BudgetHours
members.description: Planned effort in hours (for budget tracking).

members.name: Color
members.description: Bar color as a CSS color string (e.g. "#3b82f6"). Null uses the default primary color.

members.name: Comments
members.description: User comments on this task.

members.name: CustomValues
members.description: User-defined custom field values keyed by field ID.

members.name: Deadline
members.description: Optional deadline. When set and End exceeds Deadline, a warning marker is shown.

members.name: Description
members.description: Rich-text description of the task. May contain plain text or markdown.

members.name: End
members.description: End date and time of the task.

members.name: EstimationHours
members.description: Estimated effort in hours.

members.name: Id
members.description: Unique identifier of the task.

members.name: IsExpanded
members.description: Whether this task is expanded (relevant for parent tasks).

members.name: IsMilestone
members.description: When true, the task is rendered as a milestone (diamond).

members.name: LoggedHours
members.description: Actually logged hours.

members.name: ParentId
members.description: Parent task identifier. Null for root-level tasks.

members.name: PercentComplete
members.description: Completion percentage (0–100).

members.name: Priority
members.description: Priority level. Default: Medium.

members.name: Start
members.description: Start date and time of the task.

members.name: Status
members.description: Workflow status of the task. Default: Open.

members.name: TimeLog
members.description: Time log entries recorded via the built-in stopwatch.

members.name: Title
members.description: Display title of the task.

members.name: UseManualDates
members.description: When false (default), a group task bar spans min(Start)→max(End) of its direct children. Set to true to use this task's own Start/End regardless of children.
